answer: select round(100.0*sum(h)/count(*),2) from (select p.id, max(a.defensive_work_rate='high') h from Player p join Player_Attributes a on a.player_api_id=p.player_api_id where p.birthday>='1991-01-01' and a.defensive_work_rate in ('high','medium','low') group by p.id)

select t.team_short_name, count(*) as clubs, round(avg(ta.chanceCreationPassing),1) as avg_risk
from Team t
join Team_Attributes ta on ta.team_api_id=t.team_api_id
 and ta.date=(select max(x.date) from Team_Attributes x where x.team_api_id=t.team_api_id and x.date<='2014-09-19 23:59:59')
where t.team_api_id in (select team_api_id from Team_Attributes where chanceCreationPassingClass='Risky')
group by t.team_short_name having count(*)>1
order by avg_risk desc, t.team_short_name

select round(avg(height),2) from Player p where birthday>='1990-01-01' and birthday<'1996-01-01' and (select defensive_work_rate from Player_Attributes a where a.player_api_id=p.player_api_id and defensive_work_rate in ('high','medium','low') order by date desc, id desc limit 1)='medium'

select round(avg(p.weight),1) from Player p join (select player_api_id, preferred_foot, row_number() over (partition by player_api_id order by date desc, id desc) rn from Player_Attributes where preferred_foot is not null) l on l.player_api_id=p.player_api_id and l.rn=1 where l.preferred_foot='left'

select ta.buildUpPlayDribblingClass from Team_Attributes ta join Team t on t.team_api_id=ta.team_api_id where t.team_short_name='POR' and t.team_api_id in (select m.home_team_api_id from Match m join Country c on c.id=m.country_id where c.name='England') and ta.date like '2015-09-10%'
